package towerdefense

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func testState(t *testing.T) State {
	t.Helper()
	ids := [Seats]int64{1, 2, 3, 4}
	s, e := New(ids, DemoRules(), 1800000000000)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	return s
}
func TestTowerDefenseRouteAlwaysConnectsEntranceAndBase(t *testing.T) {
	s := testState(t)
	for cell := 1; cell < 24; cell++ {
		x := s
		x.Towers[cell] = Tower{1, 1, x.Rules.BuildCost}
		route := x.Route()
		if len(route) < 9 || route[0] != 0 || route[len(route)-1] != 24 {
			t.Fatal("route endpoints")
		}
		for i := 1; i < len(route); i++ {
			if route[i] == cell || distance(route[i-1], route[i]) != 1 {
				t.Fatal("illegal route")
			}
		}
	}
	s.Towers[1] = Tower{1, 1, 3}
	s.Towers[5] = Tower{1, 1, 3}
	if s.Route() != nil {
		t.Fatal("blocked entrance still reachable")
	}
}
func TestTowerDefenseBattleDeterminismAndOneStepOfflineCatchup(t *testing.T) {
	s := testState(t)
	for i, cell := range []int{1, 6, 11, 16} {
		if _, _, e := s.Apply(int64(i+1), Command{Seq: 1, Epoch: 1, Round: 1, Kind: "build", A: cell}, s.LastAt); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	}
	if e := s.Advance(s.Deadline); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	a, e := Decode(s.Encode())
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	b, e := Decode(s.Encode())
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	for range 100 {
		if a.Phase == "done" {
			break
		}
		now := a.Deadline
		if e = a.Advance(now); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if e = b.Advance(now); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if a.Encode() != b.Encode() {
			t.Fatal("replay differs")
		}
	}
	if a.Result != "won" {
		t.Fatal("reference defense lost")
	}
	s = testState(t)
	now := s.LastAt + 3600000
	if e = s.Advance(now); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if s.Tick != 0 || s.Round != 1 || s.Deadline != now+s.Rules.TickMillis {
		t.Fatal("offline skipped wave")
	}
	if e = s.Advance(now + 3600000); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if s.Tick != 1 || s.BaseHP != 12 {
		t.Fatal("offline catchup advanced more than one step")
	}
}
func TestTowerDefenseStrictBoundsAndFrozenConfiguration(t *testing.T) {
	s := testState(t)
	for _, raw := range []string{s.Encode() + "{}", strings.Repeat("x", 256*1024+1)} {
		if _, e := Decode(raw); e == nil {
			t.Fatal("invalid state accepted")
		}
	}
	s.Path[0] = 24
	if _, e := Decode(s.Encode()); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid path accepted")
	}
	s = testState(t)
	s.Towers[1] = Tower{999, 1, 3}
	if _, e := Decode(s.Encode()); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("foreign ownership accepted")
	}
	s = testState(t)
	for n := 0; n < LedgerLimit; n++ {
		s.Seats[0].Receipts = append(s.Seats[0].Receipts, Receipt{Command: Command{Seq: uint64(n + 1), Epoch: 1, Round: 1, Kind: "ready"}, Round: 1})
	}
	if _, _, e := s.Apply(1, Command{Seq: 129, Epoch: 1, Round: 1, Kind: "ready"}, s.LastAt); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("ledger overflow")
	}
	r := s.Seats[0].Receipts[0]
	if got, changed, e := s.Apply(1, r.Command, s.LastAt); e != nil || changed || got != r {
		t.Fatal("old identity evicted")
	}
}
func TestTowerDefenseCatalogReloadOnlyAffectsNewRooms(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	r := DemoRules()
	write := func() {
		b, _ := json.Marshal(r)
		if e := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "tower.json"), b, 0600); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	}
	write()
	store, e := OpenCatalog(dir)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	old, e := CaptureRules(store.Current())
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	room := testState(t)
	r.Version = "new"
	r.BuildCost++
	write()
	if _, e = store.Load(context.Background()); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	next, e := CaptureRules(store.Current())
	if e != nil || next.Hash() == old.Hash() || room.Rules != old {
		t.Fatal("existing room repriced")
	}
	r.TickMillis = 0
	write()
	if _, e = store.Load(context.Background()); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid rules accepted")
	}
}
